verification.method: scripts/verify/france.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank 1950/2026, share, growth, density, land area
Fertility 2010/2026 and highest among European countries over 30 million (build check); births 2010/2026 and fall; deaths
Births vs deaths margin 2026 and first year of more deaths (2027); net migration; range and peak to 2100
Overseas departments (Réunion, Guadeloupe, Martinique, French Guiana, Mayotte) listed separately by the UN, and their populations
Median age, life expectancy, urban share; title, meta description, Article headline, FAQ answers in JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 72 of 72 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
